''See also: [[Bastion Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Bastion is a [[Soulbound Vessel]] and the second of its kind belonging to her current wielder. Originally established by her ancestor, it functions as a [[Veil]] that provides immense defense against [[Elders]], capable of resisting almost any assault unless directed by the specific will of a [[Great Elder]]. The entity possesses a sentient, communicative presence that interacts with its wielder's mind through soothing voices and whispers. Its core purpose is centered on protection, preservation, concealment, and service, specifically regarding the safety of the [[Consultants]] and the [[Guild]]. Bastion can influence its wielder's emotions, offering comfort or inducing panic when it perceives imminent threats. It is capable of expressing opinions on safety and can become agitated or eager to combat enemies of the [[Consultants]] and servants of the [[Elders]].}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As [[Shera]]'s second [[Soulbound Vessel]], Bastion is an ancient artifact with a long history that possesses the ability to create mist. This [[Vessel]], which was once contained within a head-sized sealing box, serves as a source of power for [[Shera]] that can cause exhaustion when tapped into. Bastion manifests as a knife with a hilt, acting as a weapon that can leap toward targets like [[Calder]]'s neck or skate across an Emperor's helmet. While the entity provides a soothing, peaceful voice focused on protection and concealment, it also communicates through whispers and screams within [[Shera]]'s mind. The thickness of the mist fluctuates with Bastion's waxing and waning power, even as the entity urges [[Shera]] to find a secure room to hunker down. Ultimately, Bastion stands as an enemy of the [[Consultants]].}}
